_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `s.block.block2d` is a semio-NATIVE KIND DEFINITION — one node kind's identity and presentation, the handle kinds it declares, the handles on its rim, the compatibility relation between those kinds, its attributes, authors, camera and metadata. No symbol- or component-library format models that and none reads `.dsl.semio`, so the reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION in Python written from this subset's committed schemas, grammar and specification vectors.

oracles.rationale: A second implementation of the `s.block.block2d` node-kind document and all twenty-six typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-block-2d-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️component.json` (the ten members), `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️component.json` and `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️component.grammar.semio` (the twenty-six verbs and their argument lists), and the twenty-six committed `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` specification vectors — which give the internally tagged wire form of each verb and the two things only they state: that `update-presentation` REBUILDS the presentation from its six arguments and drops every member whose argument is null, and that an `author` keeps only the members it was given. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. A third-party library was declined, not merely absent: a symbol- or component-library format such as KiCad, Modelica or IFC's property sets carries pins or ports but has no notion of a kind-level compatibility relation between handle kinds, of a rim angle in radians, or of the presentation variant this vocabulary switches with one verb, and none of them reads this carrier. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.
